title: HYD G RSVR LO LVL
announce: ECAM, hydraulic, green reservoir low level.

actions.discrepancy: I still show the green engine 1 pump running.

actions.say: P.T.U., monitor. Expect the P.T.U. to pressurise the green system from yellow.

status: Status. Green hydraulic system: low level, anticipate loss of the green system.

For landing, expect the P.T.U. to maintain green; apply the Q.R.H. landing distance factor.
